rows.note: Use 日 as the all-purpose spoken noun for a counted 24-hour or calendar day, including a work or school day.

example.english: I was so busy at work that day that I never stopped.
example.traditional: 我返工嗰日忙到冇停過。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 go2 jat6 mong4 dou3 mou5 ting4 gwo3

rows.note: Use 日頭 for the daylight portion of a day, especially when contrasting it with nighttime.

example.english: The sun is so strong during the day, so don’t go out.
example.jyutping: jat6 tau4 gam3 maang5 m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use 節日 for a holiday or festival observed on a particular day.

example.english: This holiday is a special day for the whole family.
example.traditional: 呢個節日係全家人嘅特別日子。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zit3 jat6 hai6 cyun4 gaa1 jan4 ge3 dak6 bit6 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use 年代 for an era or period associated with a person, thing, or historical time.

example.english: I really miss that day and age; I was so happy then.
example.traditional: 我好掛住嗰個年代，嗰陣時真係好開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 go2 go3 nin4 doi6 go2 zan6 si4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1
